// diagnostic E0147

Jet.AdjacentPatternHoles

Two `{}` holes in a str-match pattern with no literal text between them

What

Two `{}` holes in a str-match pattern with no literal text between them

Why

A text pattern splits the text at the fixed characters between holes, and two holes in a row give it nothing to split on

Fix

Put literal text between adjacent `{}` holes in the string pattern.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.AdjacentPatternHoles: Tests/UI/parse_pattern_adjacent_holes.stderr.

Error: Jet.AdjacentPatternHoles: These two `{}` holes have nothing between them to split on
  --> Tests/UI/parse_pattern_adjacent_holes.jet:4:11
    |
  4 |         "{a}{b}" -> print("{a}{b}")
    |           ^^^^
 Why: A pattern splits the matched text at the fixed characters between holes; back-to-back holes give it nothing to split on
 Fix: Put literal text between them, or type them so the boundary is unambiguous
